releaseNotes: AI Chat accuracy overhaul: greetings & simple queries answered instantly without RAG pipeline.
AI Chat now gives detailed 3-5 paragraph answers with source citations instead of 2-3 line stubs.
Fixed 'No related local study material found' false negatives (lowered similarity threshold).
General knowledge queries (GD topics, current affairs) auto-use web search for better answers.
Web mode now synthesizes from multiple sources instead of returning single Wikipedia snippets.
